A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

The main takeaway from our work is that
, in recommender systems, the local structure around (user, items) pairs is sufficient for prediction, and the global structure is not necessarily needed.
, when side information is not available, it is possible to learn an inductive and generalizable recommender model by using only the (user, item, rating) matrix.
